#Hobo.Face.normal
Oh!
Lucky me, by a total accident I came across the hobo.
Now I have a chance to ask him about the cashier.
…
…
I briefly explained to him the situation without mentioning the whole bot business and asked for advice.
#Hobo.Face.smile
Hobo: Damn, that’s a tough one! Haha! I wouldn’t want to be in your skin!
Hobo: Do you know what else is tough?
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: {{punch}}Living on the streets! 
Hobo: Do you think I care about your stupid highschool drama bullshit problems about friendship and whatnot?! 
Hobo: Get the fuck out from my sight before I mug you again!
